Set.Author: Nikola Hristov
Set.Message:
docs(LICENSE): Migrate from CC0 to Land Public License v1.0

Replaced the CC0 1.0 Universal public domain dedication with the new Land Public License (LPL) v1.0. This transition:
- Establishes a copyleft license requiring contributions and derivatives to remain open under LPL terms
- Explicitly separates LPL-licensed components from External Works to preserve VS Code extension compatibility
- Introduces patent grants with defensive termination clauses
- Defines Combined Work handling to maintain Tauri/Rust core integrity while allowing permissively-licensed UI components
- Adds Bulgarian jurisdiction and dispute resolution processes
- Includes compatibility provisions for integration with GPLv3+/AGPLv3+/MPL 2.0 projects via Appendix A

BREAKING CHANGE: Transition from permissive CC0 to copyleft LPL imposes new licensing terms on contributions and distributions. All future contributions must comply with LPL requirements.

- Enhanced tree-shaking of VS Code extension dependencies
- Improved sourcemap generation for better debugging
- Updated ECMAScript target compatibility

As Playform Build handles bundling of the Shim layer and extension host adapters, this version bump ensures compatibility with newer Node.js APIs required by VS Code extension platform code while maintaining Tauri's security constraints.
